parts.name: Knob (Top Control)
parts.Basic_description: A small circular knob located on the top of the coffee machine, made of durable ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: Used to adjust brewing settings such as coffee strength or water temperature.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates around its axis to change settings.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: A hinged lid on the top of the coffee machine, made of transparent polycarbonate.
parts.Functional_description: Covers the water reservoir or coffee bean compartment to prevent contamination and spillage.
parts.Movement_description: Opens and closes via a hinge mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A soft, circular button located on the front panel, made of silicone rubber.
parts.Functional_description: Used to start or stop the brewing process.
parts.Movement_description: Moves inward when pressed and returns to its original position when released.

parts.name: Knob (Side Control)
parts.Basic_description: A small side knob made of ABS plastic, located on the front-right side of the coffee machine.
parts.Functional_description: Used to control steam or water flow for frothing milk.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates to adjust the flow rate of steam or water.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main structural body of the coffee machine, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: Houses internal components such as the water tank, heating element, and pump.
parts.Movement_description: Stationary; serves as the fixed frame for all other parts.
